The 20 December account exempts cargo and essential services; the 31 December report exempts commercial trucks and describes southbound traffic. No separate all-cohort, direction-specific implementation dates are inferred. 20 and 31 December 2020 remain confirmation dates for 22:00–06:00 and 21:00–06:00 schedules. First enforced nights, endpoints and intervening continuity remain unknown; staffing dates do not become expiry dates. The named immigration account and the later pandemic report support human-disease-control coding for the exceptional restrictions. The Chronicle body was freshly read and the exact ZimLive passage reused. This researcher authored original R06; this is a re-audit, and root must independently challenge this half. Both phases remain unlocated with dated-evidence-only display rules. A Beitbridge coordinate from a different event is not inherited.
